upgrades.lead: Your extra copies evolve a card: it gains a star and its stats go up a little. It keeps its rarity colour until the last evolution, Divine, where it turns silver.
upgrades.how1: One copy of each card always stays in your collection: only extra copies are used.
upgrades.how2: Evolutions unlock in order: 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars, then Divine (MAX).
upgrades.how3: The rarer the card, the fewer copies you need (table below).
upgrades.how4: Each evolution raises HP, attack, defense and speed, up to +{max}% at Divine. In the Battle Royale, this bonus counts at {factor}% (up to +{battleMax}%), so your skill stays decisive.
upgrades.how5: The stars at the top left of the artwork show the evolution; the card keeps its rarity colour. At Divine, it turns silver (its rarity banner keeps its colour) and shows “MAX”.
upgrades.sell1: Tap a card: the “Sell” button sells all its extra copies at once.
upgrades.sell2: “Sell my extra copies” does the same for your whole collection.
upgrades.sell3: Commons, rares and epics earn at most {cap} MemeMoney per day; rarer cards have no limit.
upgrades.sell4: Small amounts (0.1, 0.25…) add up and are never lost.
upgrades.how6: Not to be confused with Mastery, planned with the Battle Royale: by playing a character, you'll unlock purely cosmetic rewards for it (frame, trail, title).
upgrades.howAll: In your Collection, “Evolve everything” evolves every card with enough extra copies in one go.

card.title: Anatomy of a card
card.lead: Every card is a playable character in the Battle Royale, with its strengths and weaknesses. Here is what each part means, using this card as an example.
card.name: The name is at the top left; the rarity, on the bottom strip. A rarer card is a little stronger, but in battle the gap is deliberately small: your skill matters most.
card.hp: Hit points. In battle: {maxHp} HP. The flip side: the sturdier a character, the bigger it is, so the easier to hit ({radius}-unit radius).
card.atk: Attack. In battle, it multiplies your weapons' damage: × {percent}% here.
card.def: Defense. In battle, it's your armor: it reduces the damage you take by {percent}%.
card.spd: Speed. In battle, you move at {speed} units per second. Fast characters are often more fragile.
card.attack: The basic attack gives the card its style. In the Battle Royale, you start with a pistol and a combat knife, then pick up other weapons on the field or in crates: {weapons}.
card.special: Becomes your ability, to trigger whenever you want: {ability}. The higher its power, the stronger the effect.
card.energyTitle: Energy: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
card.energy: In battle, energy sets your ability's cooldown: {seconds} s here ({base} s, plus {per} s per energy point).
card.extras: The stars at the top left of the artwork show the card's evolution (“MAX” for an all-silver Divine): its stats go up a little (in battle, this counts at {factor}%). The ×n badge at the top right shows how many copies you own.
card.soon: The Battle Royale is coming soon. These values may still be adjusted to keep the game balanced.
card.example: A {weapon} bullet ({damage} damage) fired by this card leaves with {shot} damage. Against an average character (armor −{reduction}%), it deals {hit}.
